description: GP fit was launched when the narration PCD was saved, before poses.npy existed (written only at buffer close); PCD could also land in the wrong buffer directory
evidence_quote: (diff docstrings) Save poses continuously during breach so poses.npy is always available / Check if poses.npy is available before starting GP fit

description: Semantic voxels reaching the costmap from both direct mapping and narration were counted twice, inflating costmap density; fix deduplicates within half a voxel and revoxelizes
evidence_quote: (diff comment) Remove duplicate voxels to avoid double counting. This happens when the same semantic voxels come from both direct mapping and narration
ruining_rationale: Inflated cost around a cause biases avoidance but does not stop a run.
